themes.title: Beijing weaponizing processing dominance
themes.description: China's Rare Earth Price Index hit 273.5 on Jul 16 (terbium oxide +30% on the quarter); the export-control reprieve expires Nov 10, 2026, a key overhang for ex-China supply.

themes.title: China adds MP, USAR to entity list
themes.description: Beijing added 10 US entities — including MP Materials and USA Rare Earth — to its export-control list in June 2026, alongside a new violation-reporting mechanism effective Jul 1.

themes.title: Washington's playbook
themes.description: ~$2.9B in direct federal funding committed across rare-earth/magnet projects in a five-week Jun 2026 blitz (DoD, DoE, EXIM) — flowing to finished inputs (magnets, battery-grade lithium), not just ore.

bear_case.title: Commodity cycles cut both ways
bear_case.description: Lithium's 2023–25 crash shows how fast oversupply can crush miners even with strong long-term demand.

bear_case.title: China can flood the market
bear_case.description: Beijing has historically dumped supply to crush Western rare-earth economics; price floors help but don't cover everyone.

bear_case.title: Juniors dilute
bear_case.description: Developers without cash flow fund construction via repeated equity raises; USAR/LAC-type names carry meaningful dilution risk.

bear_case.title: Policy dependency
